question: What were sales last year?
why: "Sales" can mean revenue or a number of orders. Taking last year as 2025 (today is in 2026).

interpretations.label: Revenue in 2025
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'

interpretations.label: Completed orders in 2025
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: Who is our best customer?
why: "Best" has no measure: revenue or number of orders; no period given (both readings use 2024 and 2025).

interpretations.label: Highest revenue
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: Most completed orders
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY orders DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

question: What is our biggest product?
why: "Biggest" can mean revenue or units sold (2024 and 2025, completed orders).

interpretations.label: Highest revenue
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.products p USING (product_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: Most units sold
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(l.quantity) AS units FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.products p USING (product_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many active customers do we have?

interpretations.label: Any completed order ever
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: What is the average order size in 2025?
why: "Size" can mean value or number of units (completed orders).

interpretations.label: Average value
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(t), 2) AS avg_value FROM (SELECT sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) AS t FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.order_id) x

interpretations.label: Average units
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(t), 2) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT sum(l.quantity) AS t FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.order_id) x

question: Which region performed best in 2025?
why: "Best" can mean the most revenue or the fastest growth over 2024.

interpretations.label: Most revenue in 2025
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT o.region_id AS region, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.region_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: Fastest growth over 2024
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT o.region_id AS region, round(100 * (sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01') / sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on < DATE '2025-01-01') - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.region_id ORDER BY growth_pct DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is our return rate?
why: Returned units over units sold, or orders with a return over all orders (completed, 2024 and 2025).

interpretations.label: Units returned over units sold, percent
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT sum(r.quantity) FROM sales.returns r JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed') / (SELECT sum(l.quantity) FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed'), 2) AS return_rate_pct

interpretations.label: Orders with a return over orders, percent
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.returns r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id)) / count(*), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sales.orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed'

question: How much did we discount in 2025?

interpretations.label: Average discount percent
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(l.discount_pct), 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How did revenue change in 2025?

interpretations.label: Change in percent
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT round(100 * (sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01') / sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on < DATE '2025-01-01') - 1), 1) AS change_pct FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed'
